name: Ganbara Knight

name: Achacha Archer

name: ZW - Unicorn Spear
extDescription: You can target 1 face-up "Number C39: Utopia Ray" you control; equip this card from your hand to that target. It gains 1900 ATK. name: Old Vindictive Magician

name: Swords of Burning Light

name: Blustering Winds

name: Ego Boost

name: Gagagarevenge

When this card is sent to the Graveyard because the equipped monster was used as an Xyz Material: All Xyz Monsters you currently control gain 300 ATK.

name: Xyz Unit

name: The A. Forces
extDescription: All Warrior-Type monsters you control gain 200 ATK for each face-up Warrior or Spellcaster-Type monster you control.

name: Reinforcement of the Army
extDescription: Add 1 Level 4 or lower Warrior-Type monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: The Warrior Returning Alive
extDescription: Target 1 Warrior-Type monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

name: Puzzle Reborn
extDescription: If exactly 1 monster you control (and no other cards) is destroyed by a card effect: Target that monster; Special Summon that target.

name: Gagagashield
extDescription: Target 1 face-up Spellcaster-Type monster you control; equip this card to that target. Twice per turn, it cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.

name: Copy Knight

name: Dark Bribe
